name: smtp-utf8-rfc822-mailbox-permit-strict-9549-exact-valid
description: Strict-RFC-9549 reading: a mailbox-form rfc822 permit applied to a SmtpUTF8Mailbox SAN compares on the domain only. When both the constraint's domain and the SAN's domain match (and the local parts happen to also match), the leaf is valid.
notes: Botan-conservative would reject the same chain (see `smtp-utf8-rfc822-mailbox-permit-invalid`). This variant isolates the exact-mailbox sub-case of the strict-9549 same-domain rule.
